The documented form also does not run: `pnpm start -- http --port=3952` -> `$ node bin/duckbrain.js -- http --port=3952` / `Unknown command: --` / `[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.` / EXIT:1. AC2 FAIL: `node examples/http-api/client.js` -> `SyntaxError: Cannot use 'import.meta' outside a module` at client.js:115, CLIENT_EXIT:1 (package.json is "type":"commonjs"; file still .js), reproduced with and without a live daemon. AC3 FAIL (reproduced twice): second instance on occupied :3945 printed `[duckbrain] HTTP server started at http://127.0.0.1:3945` (banner printed), overwrote the live occupant's pidfile (md5 2591516f... -> 2593058e..., pid 2591516 -> 2593058), then deleted the pidfile entirely and killed the occupant (/health 503 -> 000, occupant process DEAD).
